name: phasewire
description: Persistent visual control layer for harness-agnostic development workflows

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n service,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @phasewire/server" "npm run dev -w @phasewire/web"
scripts.quality:static: npm run build -w @phasewire/core && npm run build -w @phasewire/server && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.quality:commit: npm run quality:structure && npm run quality:static && npm run quality:test
scripts.quality:push: npm run quality:commit && npm run quality:build && npm run quality:security && npm run quality:browser
scripts.adapters:install: npm run build -w @phasewire/cli && node packages/cli/dist/index.js adapters install --host all --scope project
